buildCommand: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('client')) { execSync('npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else if (fs.existsSync('src/app.ts')) { console.log('Server directory detected'); } else { execSync('npm install && npm run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
